headline: Committee takes public testimony on fiscal year 27 budget at Kīhei meeting

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.summary: The committee met in Kīhei with the fiscal year 27 budget as its only item. Testifiers raised the Citizen Forester Program, farm water access, and Wailuku Water's $13 million offer. Mediation Services of Maui asked for $154,000 more.
meeting.recap: The committee met in Kīhei at six o'clock.[[0:00:17]] The only agenda item was the fiscal year 27 budget.[[0:02:31]] Maui Green and Beautiful said the Mayor's budget includes $77,000 for the Citizen Forester Program.[[0:14:18]] A testifier asked questions about a planned Central Maui and South Maui desalination plant.[[0:19:16]] A testifier said the Council defunded wetland restoration the last two years.[[0:23:19]] A testifier said Wailuku Water offered to sell its damaged water system to the County for $13 million.[[0:25:29]] A testifier said farmers cannot plant another crop if they get no water by mid-June.[[0:27:14]] Mediation Services of Maui asked for $154,000 more, for a total of $285,000.[[1:30:07]] A long-term recovery group said it finished two homes in Lahaina and is rebuilding three more.[[2:02:15]]
meeting.next: Member Cook said he would talk with a testifier after the meeting about a road near the high school.

moments.q: "The county stands to lose $1.5 million in federal subsidies"

issues.oneLine: Mediation Services of Maui asked for more County money as eviction cases rise.
issues.why: The director said the group received 82 eviction notices in March and 22 more in the first two weeks of April.
issues.brief: The director said 80% of Act 202 mediations ended in an agreement between landlords and tenants.[[#1]] The group is in the proposed budget for $135,000.[[#2]]
